linesEn: Ugh, I'm bored out of my mind...
Just how much longer are we going to be flying?!

linesZhTw: 了大陸西北部…從方向看來
linesZhCn: 了大陆西北部…从方向看来
linesEn: It is truly astonishing. We crossed the entire northwestern continent in a single day...
Judging by our course, we should now be approaching the border...
...mountain range, if I am not mistaken!

linesZhTw: 一帶全是未熄滅的火山啊！
聽說那裡也是惡魔族的根據
linesZhCn: 一带全是未熄灭的火山啊！
听说那里也是恶魔族的根据
linesEn: Do you mean Demon Mountain? That entire region is covered in active volcanoes!
Word has it that's also the stronghold of the demons...

linesZhTw: 地…難道惡魔族也和這件事
linesZhCn: 地…难道恶魔族也和这件事
linesEn: Could the demon race be involved in this as well?

linesZhTw: 棲息在黑暗和地獄般的炎熱
中，和其他種族向不往來，
linesZhCn: 栖息在黑暗和地狱般的炎热
中，和其他种族向不往来，
linesEn: Hardly a surprise. Demons thrive in darkness and hellish heat, keeping completely to themselves.

linesZhTw: 誰曉得它們暗地裡會搞出些
linesZhCn: 谁晓得它们暗地里会搞出些
linesEn: Who knows what foul schemes they've been concocting in secret!
Look sharp, everyone. It seems our welcoming committee has arrived!
Wh-What is that? A giant flying boulder with people riding on it?!

linesZhTw: 置，那些人是乘坐在上面的
linesZhCn: 置，那些人是乘坐在上面的
linesEn: Idiot! That is a magic-propelled flying vessel, and those are passengers!

linesZhTw: 的空域前往火焰之谷嗎？』
linesZhCn: 的空域前往火焰之谷吗？』
linesEn: What are they scheming? Are they trying to breach our airspace to reach the Valley of Flames?

linesZhTw: 任何人從空中或地下經過此
linesZhCn: 任何人从空中或地下经过此
linesEn: His Majesty explicitly forbade anyone from passing through here, by air or underground!

linesZhTw: 『所以現在我們要宰了那些傢
linesZhCn: 『所以现在我们要宰了那些家
linesEn: Then our orders are simple: butcher the lot of them! Attack!
Whoa there! They don't look like they're here to chat—they're ready to brawl!
A battle way up in the air? We'll be at a terrible disadvantage!

linesZhTw: 『我們的伙伴中還有幾個會飛
的，勉強可以牽制敵方的攻
勢，你們只要在地上確實消
linesZhCn: 『我们的伙伴中还有几个会飞
的，勉强可以牵制敌方的攻
势，你们只要在地上确实消
linesEn: A few among us have wings and can take to the skies to hold their assault at bay.
The rest of you just focus on striking down any foe that lands on our platform!

linesZhTw: 麼好怕的！我們先打了再說
linesZhCn: 么好怕的！我们先打了再说
linesEn: They're just flapping some wings, nothing we can't handle! Let's take them down first!

linesZhTw: 『敵軍似乎是負責鎮守這一帶
的空域，以防止他人侵入…
看來在惡魔之山一定有什麼
事發生，大家要有心理準備
linesZhCn: 『敌军似乎是负责镇守这一带
的空域，以防止他人侵入…
看来在恶魔之山一定有什么
事发生，大家要有心理准备
linesEn: Those forces appeared to be guarding this airspace against intruders...
Something dire must be transpiring at Demon Mountain. Steel yourselves, everyone—we must be prepared for the unexpected...
Hey, old man Jonah, doesn't it feel like we're losing altitude?!
Indeed... and we are descending faster by the second!
Aaaahhh! Thor, I'm terrified!
Hold on tight to me, Celia! Uni, get over here too!
...Okay!
Ah...! Ares, my head is spinning...
Are you alright? Here, hold on to me!
Thank you, Ares... You're always so kind...

linesZhTw: 在的女孩子要比以前大膽多
了，連現在這種狀況都可以
linesZhCn: 在的女孩子要比以前大胆多
了，连现在这种状况都可以
linesEn: See what I mean, old man Jonah? Girls these days are far bolder than in our youth.
Even plummeting through the air is turned into an opportunity to flirt!

linesZhTw: 拿來作調情的機會，看來我
linesZhCn: 拿来作调情的机会，看来我
linesEn: I suppose the two of us really are relics of the past!

linesZhTw: 一腳踹下這飛行岩的話，我
建議你在我們著陸前最好保
linesZhCn: 一脚踹下这飞行岩的话，我
建议你在我们着陆前最好保
linesEn: Sylpha, if you don't wish to be kicked right off this flying boulder by the ladies...
...I strongly advise you to remain silent until we make landfall.
